resources.string: Enter your PIN to look after %1$s\'s phone.
That PIN isn\'t right. Try again.
LMNOPhone asks for your PIN for each change, so nobody else can make one if the phone is put down.
Wait %1$s before trying again. You can use the recovery code you wrote down instead. Calls, texts and Emergency still work.
Wait %1$s before trying again. You can use %2$s\'s recovery code now instead. %3$s\'s PIN still works. Calls, texts and Emergency still work.
Enter the recovery code you wrote down. Upper and lower case don\'t matter.
This code can\'t get past Google\'s reset protection if the phone is ever wiped. Only your Google account can do that.
This code only resets your PIN. It doesn\'t skip any wait.
A change is waiting that was started with your PIN: %1$s. Setting a new PIN cancels it.
Setting a new PIN cancels the change that\'s waiting: %1$s.
The two PINs aren\'t the same. Try again.
LMNOPhone couldn\'t confirm the change. Try your old PIN first. If it doesn\'t work, use the new one.
Here is your new recovery code
If you ever forget your PIN, this code lets you choose a new one. It\'s shown once only. Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe, away from this phone and away from %1$s.
If you ever forget your PIN, this code lets you choose a new one. It\'s shown once only. Write it on paper and keep it away from this phone. It only resets your PIN: it doesn\'t skip any wait.
Only your PIN and code changed. %1$s\'s PIN and code are the same as before.
This is for adding apps and keeping the phone working. You can\'t see %1$s\'s messages, photos, or what %1$s does in apps.
You hold the PIN. LMNOPhone adds waits so that distraction takes effort. It\'s friction, not a lock.
Done – back to the home screen
Let someone look after this phone
%1$s asked for: \"%2$s\". This app is %3$s, made by %4$s. Make sure it\'s the one %1$s meant.
Checked for version %1$s. This is version %2$s.
Not reviewed yet – this app may open web pages inside it
The LMNOPhone team checks apps for this and writes a note for each one. They haven\'t checked %1$s. To ask them to, tell %2$s.
Add an app nobody has checked?

The LMNOPhone team hasn\'t checked whether %1$s can show web pages inside it. Some apps can show any website, which would let %2$s reach websites this phone normally keeps out. If you\'re not sure, wait: ask %3$s to get it checked first. You can also add it now and remove it later.
It will appear on the home screen, below the other apps. Allowed: %1$s. Not allowed: %2$s.
Done. %1$s is on the home screen.
%1$s stays hidden. It can\'t be opened.
%1$s will disappear from the home screen straight away. Nothing is deleted: if you add it again later, %2$s\'s things in it will still be there.

Choose together with %1$s. %2$s won\'t ask %1$s about these later, and %1$s can\'t change them alone. If %1$s wants a change, you change it together, with the phone in your hands: \"Apps on this phone\" → %2$s → \"What %2$s can use\". If you choose \"Don\'t allow\", the parts of %2$s that need it won\'t work.
Android doesn\'t let LMNOPhone switch this on. Parts of %1$s that need it won\'t work.
Find it in the Play Store
Remove this request? %1$s won\'t be told.
People who look after %1$s\'s phone. Each has their own PIN and recovery code. You are equals: either of you can add apps, open the Play Store, or turn LMNOPhone off.
Hand your place to someone else
Switch to %1$s looking after this phone
Takes 24 hours, and %1$s gets a text
%1$s will look after %2$s\'s phone with you, as an equal. %1$s needs to be here now, with their own phone or computer, for about 15 minutes.
Hand your place to someone else?
%1$s will take your place. Your PIN and recovery code will stop working. %1$s needs to be here now, with their own phone or computer, for about 15 minutes.
%1$s will no longer look after %2$s\'s phone. %1$s\'s PIN and recovery code will stop working.
This waits 24 hours of the phone being on. Time while the phone is off doesn\'t count. %1$s will get a text now, and anyone holding the phone can cancel until then.
%1$s. It happens after at least 24 hours of the phone being on. Until then, %2$s\'s PIN does nothing, and anyone holding the phone can cancel.

%1$s will hold the PIN instead of %2$s. LMNOPhone keeps everything as it is, but %1$s can open things up after a 10-minute wait, twice a day. It\'s friction, not a lock: %1$s can always remove it by waiting 24 hours, or by wiping the phone. This waits 24 hours of the phone being on. %2$s will get a text now, and anyone can cancel until then.
Let someone look after this phone?

A trusted person will hold the PIN instead of you, and add apps with you. This waits 24 hours of the phone being on, and nothing can make it shorter. Until then, your waits and limits stay as they are, and the new person\'s PIN does nothing.
It happens after about %1$s, if the phone stays on. Time while the phone is off doesn\'t count.
It will happen after %1$s, once the phone has been on for 24 hours. Time while the phone is off doesn\'t count, so this can move later.
Until then, LMNOPhone works as usual.
Anyone holding this phone can cancel it. No PIN is needed.
%1$s will get a text either way.
%1$s will get a text saying it was cancelled.
To do it later, someone has to start it again, and the 24 hours start again.
LMNOPhone couldn\'t save this yet and is trying again. The change won\'t happen while this is unfinished.
%1$s will get a text about it.
This change is being made now. It can\'t be cancelled at this point.
LMNOPhone is turning off now. It can\'t be cancelled at this point. Calls, texts and Emergency keep working.
%1$s: this happens after about %2$s, if the phone stays on.
Anyone holding the phone can cancel it until then, from the home screen.
Only one change can wait at a time. Waiting now: %1$s. Cancel it, or wait until it\'s done, then start this one.
Only one change can wait at a time. Being made now: %1$s. Wait until it\'s done, then start this one.
This didn\'t start. Nothing has changed. Try again.
Skipping needs your recovery code, not your PIN. You\'ll then choose a new PIN and get a new recovery code. %1$s will get a text saying you skipped the wait.
%1$s will start now. It can\'t be cancelled after this.
Reset protection not updated – call the helper

LMNOPhone is trying to %1$s, but Google\'s reset protection didn\'t accept the new list yet. LMNOPhone keeps trying. Until this works, nothing changes: the trusted people are still %2$s, with the same PINs. Calls, texts and Emergency work. Until this is fixed, we can\'t say whose Google account a wipe would ask for.
LMNOPhone puts reset protection back for %1$s. %2$s\'s details are thrown away.
Still stopping. LMNOPhone keeps trying, and won\'t start the change again. Call %1$s.
LMNOPhone recovered from an interrupted change
LMNOPhone is on, with all its protections. If you were changing something, check whether it happened before you start it again.

LMNOPhone couldn\'t finish checking who looks after this phone, so it\'s holding everything as it is. Calls, texts and Emergency work. Repair tries again and shows what went wrong. It doesn\'t change anything else.
Open the Play Store for 10 minutes
Open full phone settings for 5 minutes
Stay with the phone until you tap Done.
Keep the phone in your hands. Don\'t give it to %1$s while the Play Store is open: it can show web pages, so the phone isn\'t simple for these minutes.
Keep the phone in your hands. Don\'t give it to %1$s while settings are open: they can show web pages and change things LMNOPhone relies on.
Search for the app, tap Install, and wait until it says Open. Then go back to the home screen (swipe up from the bottom of the screen). LMNOPhone checks the phone, then shows Done.
Make the change, then go back to the home screen (swipe up from the bottom of the screen). LMNOPhone checks the phone, then shows Done.
The Play Store also closes if the screen turns off, a call comes in, or after 10 minutes.
Settings also closes if the screen turns off, a call comes in, or after 5 minutes.
Some changes get put back afterwards, such as the texting app or the keyboard. Ordinary changes, like ringtone or Wi-Fi, are kept.

You\'ll open the Play Store\'s list of updates and update anything that\'s waiting. Afterwards, LMNOPhone asks which apps didn\'t update. About 10 minutes. Updates carry on even after the Play Store closes.
In the Play Store: tap your Google picture or initial at the top right, then Manage apps & device, then Updates available. Tap Update all if you see it.
Look at what the Play Store showed you.
Tick each one. They\'ll stay on your list until they\'re sorted.
Enter your PIN to confirm you looked at the Play Store\'s update list. The next check will be due on %1$s.
This takes a few seconds. Keep the phone with you.
The Play Store is closed again. You can hand the phone back to %1$s.
Not ready to hand back – call the helper
Something didn\'t go back the way it should. Keep the phone with you. Tap Check again once; if this screen comes back, call %1$s, your helper. Calls, texts and Emergency still work.
Keep the phone with you. You\'ll need a computer to fix this; see the setup guide, \'When something goes wrong\'.
Record sound, such as voice messages
Show things near you, or let %1$s know where you are
See and change the people in your contacts
Make calls and see who is calling
See who you called and who called you
Connect to speakers, headphones and watches
Photos and videos · Music and audio
See the photos, videos or music on this phone
Show alerts at the top of the screen
Count steps or read heart rate
